blocks.text: Second Samuel attributes the census incitement to the LORD's anger, whereas First Chronicles attributes it to an adversary; harmonizing, developmental, and distinct-source explanations remain debated.
First Chronicles attributes the census incitement to an adversary or Satan, whereas 2 Samuel begins with the LORD's anger; source, agency, developmental, and harmonizing explanations remain debated.
Second Samuel moves from David's accession and kingdom consolidation through ark and dynasty promise to royal abuse, household violence, rebellion, grief, and a four-part closing appendix.
